items.title: Holman Bill — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...you asked if there was a different session. Here’s one that’s from May of ’54. Some of the personnel on here: Bill Perkins, Jerry Coker.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. I was really – I was delirious, because Capitol even put out a single, a 45, of a couple of the tunes on there. For a jazz guy to have a single was unheard of. I was really on top of the world for a few weeks.

The next one was the one I mentioned about Woody Herman. So I‟ve got a different – you asked if there was a different session. Here‟s one that‟s from May of ‟54. Some of the personnel on here: Bill Perkins, Jerry Coker. As I mentioned earlier, Panama Francis, playing drums.
